Pass 40 (built green): (1) bulk-haul heavy-stack fallback; (2) cross-level RMB null-coalesce vs foreign GetOptions postfixes; (3) equal storage-priority never crosses; (4) VANILLA HAULABILITY PARITY - non-alwaysHaulable things (stone/slag chunks) are cross-hauled only when DESIGNATED (Orders->Haul) or in storage, matching vanilla; corpses (alwaysHaulable) unaffected.
body:
# As above, So below

## Pitch
Real, robust z-levels capped at three per column: sky above, surface, basement below. Priorities: (1) visual clarity from the sky with a live surface view; (2) performance; (3) **full vanilla parity — the column is ONE BIG MAP**.

## TESTING RULE (USER DIRECTIVE 2026-07-25)
**NEVER launch tests with the user's full modlist (isolated=false).** 900+ mods bury our diagnostics. ALWAYS isolated=true with a minimal companionMods set (Dubwise.DubsBadHygiene for DBH, Krkr.rule56 for CAI 5000, Mehni.PickUpAndHaul for bulk-haul) + build a fresh column via the dev action "As above\\AB: ensure sky + basement". NOTE: the auto-PIN of that palette entry can log "Could not find node from path ... Removing." at startup (pin loads before debug actions register) - the action still exists in the debug menu; run it manually. Non-isolated only if the user explicitly asks.

## Locked decisions
- Standalone C# + Harmony. Soft compat via detection/reflection. ABGuard kill switches, fail open + in-game Message. Vanilla sentence case, ASCII only.
- Cap 3 levels. Cross-gap GAMEPLAY only sky<->surface; basement routing-only. Below view PLUMB.
- Selection survives column view switches AND pawn level-changes. All levels real maps; viewing swaps Find.CurrentMap. Sky terrain: AB_OpenAir + AB_RoofSurface / AB_MountainTop.
- **See-below = RENDER overlay + per-interaction input hooks, NOT a general see-through.**
- **Designators OUT OF SCOPE (pass 33).**
- Logistics doctrine: every ferry MONOTONE. Storage=vanilla+capacity clamp + delivered-level retention (pass 34).
- **WORK doctrine (pass 36): the column is ONE BIG MAP for work priority.**
- **HAULING / STORAGE-PRIORITY doctrine (pass 37, REFINED pass 40):** ONE BIG MAP for storage priority, but a cross-level storage move fires ONLY when the destination tier STRICTLY beats the best storage the item can reach on its OWN level. Equal (or lower) priority on another level NEVER invokes a cross-level haul (user directive 2026-07-26). Enforced in `CrossLevelHaul.TargetLevelFor`. Explicit intent (Allow Tool Haul Urgently -> ignorePins) still crosses. Monotone.
- **HAULABILITY PARITY doctrine (pass 40, user directive 2026-07-26):** cross-level auto-haul mirrors vanilla's own haulability gate. A NON-alwaysHaulable thing (stone / slag chunks) is only auto-hauled when it has a vanilla Haul DESIGNATION (Orders -> Haul) or is already in storage; vanilla leaves undesignated loose chunks be, so we must too. Corpses are `alwaysHaulable=true` and unaffected (crypt hauling preserved). Enforced in `TargetLevelFor` mirroring `ListerHaulables.ShouldBeHaulable` / `HaulAIUtility.PawnCanAutomaticallyHaul`. Fast-check callers (our HaulableEver-scanning givers) previously bypassed this via `PawnCanAutomaticallyHaulFast`, which skips the gate.
- **COMBAT doctrine:** spawn projectiles on the TARGET map, own the warmup/burst/cooldown driver. Turret support CAPABILITY-based.
- **COMBAT VISUALS (pass 38): REAL 1:1 projectile.** · **FOG-OF-WAR (pass 39): optional CAI 5000.**
- **Soft-compat HARD RULE (pass 35):** foreign types never in a SIGNATURE/field. CAI reflection-only.
- **RE-ENTRANCY HARD RULE (pass 40):** when we RE-ENTER a vanilla method we also patch (FloatMenuMakerMap.GetOptions), a FOREIGN prefix may SKIP the original and leave null out-params/returns. Coalesce at the boundary before handing back to the outer caller or foreign POSTFIXES.

# PASS 40 — HOTFIX WAVE (END-USER REPORTS + HAUL DOCTRINE) (BUILT GREEN 0/0, pending in-game verify)
**FIX 1 — cross-level bulk-haul loop:** with PUAH/Hauler's Dream, hauls route through `CrossLevelHaulJob.BuildBulk` (INVENTORY, mass-gated). A stack too heavy for free space picks up 0 and the driver walked the whole queue lifting nothing forever. FIX: `Build` bulk-loads only when `CountToPickUpUntilOverEncumbered(seed) > 0`, else `BuildSingle` (carry-in-hands); driver stops gathering once a visit lifts nothing (`lastPickupOk`). NOTE stone chunks are mass 25, so an empty colonist still bulk-loads ~3 - this fix only diverts genuinely-too-heavy stacks / already-loaded pawns.
**FIX 2 — cross-level RMB red error (Melee Animation NRE):** our GetOptions prefix RE-ENTERS GetOptions in `BuildOptions`; a foreign prefix (bed-ownership mod) skips the vanilla original, leaving list+context null; Melee's GetOptions POSTFIX NREs on the null `__result`. FIX: coalesce the re-entrant result to a non-null list + ensure non-null context, inside `BuildOptions` and at the prefix return-false boundary.
**FIX 3 — equal-tier storage never crosses (user directive):** `TargetLevelFor` discards any non-`beatsLocal` storage verdict unless `ignorePins`.
**FIX 4 — VANILLA HAULABILITY PARITY for chunks (user directive 2026-07-26 "make sure we have vanilla parity with rock chunks being hauled when designated via the orders menu"):** `TargetLevelFor` now rejects a non-`alwaysHaulable` thing (stone/slag chunk) unless it has a `DesignationDefOf.Haul` designation OR is `IsInValidStorage()` (or `ignorePins`). Mirrors `ListerHaulables.ShouldBeHaulable`. Before, we used the fast haul check which SKIPS that gate, so undesignated chunks were cross-hauled (non-vanilla) and jobs were issued for things vanilla's listers reject - the likely driver of the "pawns walk to chunks and abandon them / loop" reports. Now: designate chunks (Orders->Haul) and they cross to the best storage in the column exactly like vanilla hauls them locally; undesignated loose chunks are left alone.

**Open after FIX 4 (needs in-game verify):** the reporter's BUG3 ("pawns sometimes time out before starting ANY job, loop") is HYPOTHESIZED to be the undesignated-chunk job churn removed by FIX 4; if it persists after designating chunks, investigate the pass-36 better-work migration (`TryMigrateForBetterWork` in CrossLevelWork.cs, runs on every JobGiver_Work.TryIssueJobPackage) for a preempt loop. BUG1/BUG2 hinge on whether the reporter DESIGNATED the chunks and whether the remote stockpile was STRICTLY higher vs equal priority - both are now governed by FIX 3 + FIX 4.

# PASS 39 — OPTIONAL CAI 5000 (Krkr.rule56): FOG OF WAR + CROSS-LEVEL VISION (phases 1-3 built green, pending verify)
# PASS 38 — CROSS-LEVEL COMBAT VISUALS · 37 STORAGE-PRIORITY HAUL · 36 ONE-BIG-MAP WORK (VERIFIED) · 36b AIM POSE (VERIFIED) · 36c MODDED TURRET · 35 DBH/GRAVSHIP/DELETE/LEVELGEN · 34 HARDENING · 33 SEE-BELOW INPUT (VERIFIED)

## Modern Dev Tools integration — SHIPPED About/known-issues.json (inert without MDT).

## REMOVED FEATURES
SKYLIGHTS (r7). MOUNTAIN RIVERS + WATERFALLS (r12). Stairwell heat exchange (2026-07-21). CROSS-LEVEL TRACERS (p38). Equal-tier lateral cross-level storage moves (p40). **Auto-haul of UNDESIGNATED loose chunks across levels (p40 - now requires vanilla Haul designation, matching vanilla).**

## VERIFIED (USER)
RMB cross-level · basement · Batch A · mech charge · bill supply + mech RMB · p33 see-below input · p36 work priority · p36b aim pose.

## FEATURE LEDGER
RMB 1:1 (VERIFIED) · basement (VERIFIED) · haul/ferry (p37 storage-priority; **p40 strictly-better-only + vanilla haulability gate**; bulk heavy-stack fallback p40) · below lighting · animal flows · mech charge (VERIFIED) · elevation/drag-box/targeter/hover (VERIFIED) · selection-across-stairs (p33) · one-big-map work (p36, VERIFIED) · aim pose (p36b, VERIFIED) · modded turret fire (p36c) · combat visuals (p38) · CAI 5000 p1-3 (p39) · cross-level RMB re-entrancy coalesce (p40) · MDT known-issues.json. OUT OF SCOPE: cross-level designators, non-projectile turrets, feeding CAI threat-AI across the gap.

## Compat
DBH/VEF/Rimefeller/VCHE · Biomes! Caverns · Alpha Biomes · BM+MO · Odyssey+VLE · Misc. Robots/++ · **Pick Up And Haul / Hauler's Dream (bulk cross-level haul; heavy-stack fallback p40)** · Allow Tool (Haul Urgently bypasses the strictly-better + designation gates) · Ancient urban ruins · CE (p38) · Achtung!/Reverse/Giddy-up/Vehicle Framework/Windows/Declutter/Animal Tab/Colonist Bar KF · Trader Airships, Hospitality · BAM · PO/Dubs Analyzer/TPT · WVC Work Modes · Stratum · Sand & Snow Coverage · Modern Dev Tools · Perspective: Ores · CAI 5000 / Krkr.rule56 (p39) · **Melee Animation / Float Sub-Menus / other GetOptions-patching mods (p40 coalesce)** · turrets: any Building_Turret w/ projectile verb (p36c) · INCOMPAT: MultiFloors, Z-Levels Beta, Strata · UNSUPPORTED: RimThreaded, non-projectile/CE-verb turrets across levels.

## STANDING TEST QUEUE (run ISOLATED + dev-built column)
**PASS 40 (TOP):**
- FIX 4 (haulability parity, no companion needed): drop loose stone chunks on the basement, chunk stockpile on the GROUND. Undesignated -> pawns must LEAVE them (vanilla parity). Designate them (Orders -> Haul) -> pawns must carry them up to the ground stockpile. Confirm no walk-to-chunk-then-abandon loop.
- FIX 3 (storage priority): two chunk stockpiles SAME priority (basement + ground), designated basement chunks -> hauled to the BASEMENT (local, nearest); raise GROUND higher -> now cross up; lower back to equal -> crossing stops. Allow Tool Haul Urgently still crosses on equal tier.
- FIX 1 (companion Mehni.PickUpAndHaul): designated heavy stacks cross without the walk-no-pickup loop; light designated items still bulk-scoop several per trip.
- FIX 2 (companion co.uk.epicguru.meleeanimation): cross-level RMB must not throw "Error trying to make float menu"; Melee options still appear same-map (null path not forceable locally w/o a GetOptions-skipping mod).
- WATCH BUG3: after designating chunks, confirm pawns no longer time out before starting jobs / loop.
**PASS 39 CAI 5000** (Krkr.rule56). **38 · 37 · 36c · 35** queues; compat/perf/CE-absent/translation/soak/publishing.

## DEV DIAGNOSTIC SUITE
AB: ensure sky+basement · basement/light/RMB/below-view diagnostics · cross-gap combat / auto-engage / targeting-hub self-tests · CAI fog self-test (p39).

## Status
2026-07-26 (pass 40, BUILT GREEN 0/0, pending in-game verify): FOUR haul/menu fixes. (1) bulk-haul heavy-stack fallback + no walk-the-queue; (2) cross-level RMB red-error null-coalesce (Melee Animation postfix); (3) equal storage-priority no longer crosses; (4) VANILLA HAULABILITY PARITY - `TargetLevelFor` now requires a non-alwaysHaulable thing (stone/slag chunk) to be DESIGNATED (Orders->Haul) or in storage before cross-hauling, mirroring `ListerHaulables.ShouldBeHaulable`; corpses (alwaysHaulable) unaffected. FIX 4 also the leading hypothesis for the end-user BUG3 job-loop (undesignated-chunk job churn). Testing ISOLATED + dev column; PUAH + Melee Animation companions.
